subject: chemistry
content: The molar volume of liquid benzene (density = 0.877 g mL<sup>-1</sup>) increases by a factor of 2750 as it vaporises at 20<sup>o</sup>C and that of liquid toluene (density = 0.867 g mL<sup>-1</sup>) increases by a factor of 7720 at 20<sup>o</sup>C. A solution of benzene and toluene at 20<sup>o</sup>C has vapour pressure of 46.0 Torr. Find the mole fraction of benzene in the vapour above the solution.
